test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 1 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A, B, C, D, E, F and G were seven kings, sitting around a circular table, facing the centre. They were equidistant to one another. Only E was sitting between F and C. A was third to the left of G. Only D was sitting between A and B. G was sitting to the immediate left of C. Which king was sitting to the immediate left of G?
solution:
**Given:**

A, B, C, D, E, F and G were seven kings, sitting around a circular table, facing the centre.

Solution :

(1) Only E was sitting between F and C.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6fd9b9d91368f36b36fdb6c151629df0e37cec91b1cc10889ba9981fa966987e.png] 

(2) G was sitting to the immediate left of C. Case 2 is eliminated and only case 1 is possible.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4660be841ea1ef6d86633cc9b427607a42d94b1edca0c19940c2ff80f496e1ff.png] 

(3) A was third to the left of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fc53aeecde471233db339695a5b59a42bc22a2511aa3099cef26be346a950235.png] 

(4) Only D was sitting between A and B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/155adb5a53978773ef91af2b1308f9a4ef20ee2c14e3ac77d765da0b5cfcefcb.png] 

Here, **king B** was sitting to the immediate left of G.

**Hence, 'option 2' is the correct answer.**
